newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, PCX to list Roslyn Bancorp options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, PCX to list Roslyn Bancorp options.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) and the Pacific Exchange (PCX) said Monday they would list Roslyn Bancorp Inc options on April 21.
The exchanges said the options would have opening strike prices of 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2, with initial expirations in May, June, July and October.
At the PCX, where the options have been allocated to pit representatives Lynn Jolly and Kit Woolsey, position limits of 10,500 contracts have been set.
O.T.A. LP has been named Designated Primary Market Maker (DPM) for the options at the CBOE.
